services.value: ALS provides environmental and laboratory testing services including environmental site assessment & remediation, environmental monitoring, water industry and air monitoring, industrial & occupational hygiene, PFAS testing, equipment reliability, oil analysis, coolant & transformer fluid testing, and fuel & DEF testing. It also provides consulting, training & reporting, food and agricultural testing (including AgriSciences), mining-related services such as mine site operations and geochemistry/geoanalytics, plus pharmaceutical & healthcare and analytical services.
